fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-03-22, a rented premises near Anbu Park Main Street in Trichy was allegedly occupied by a person after the lease ended, and the keys were not returned. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-03-21 at roughly 15:40. Jagan Gopal approached Trichy Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000108. A further person, Jeeva Muthu, a person who arranged the contact, using the number 9000000124, is stated to be associated with the incident. Elango Shankar (mobile 9000000317) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Premises allegedly occupied after the lease period ended.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, suspect, associate, main street, photograph, afternoon, documents
